title: PayloadTooLarge payload
description: 413. The request body exceeds 1 MiB (RequestBodyLimitLayer, crates/secrets-http/src/lib.rs:57); refused before the handler authenticates, by the layer from the declared length or by `JsonBody` from the bytes read, and answered in the refusal shape with code `too-large` (crates/secrets-http/src/lib.rs:59-60, 461-469, 482-484).
